scope: Reconstruct the already reported A1 noisy-history NMSE panel from the exact prior recipe and add paired, same-origin four-user downlink RZF metrics for all six predictors at every history-noise level.

formal_test_gate.required_before_run: Root review of protocol, runner, hashes, and synthetic tests.
formal_test_gate.test_access_disclosure: The formal test panel was accessed for the historical A1 result. This is a fixed post hoc replay; no tuning or model selection is permitted from these outputs.

prior_a1_binding.comparison: Reconstructed environment NMSE for Lite/LMMSE/Ridge/AR/Kalman/Persistence must match the original row with the same speed, nominal history SNR, environment ID, and MAT SHA.
prior_a1_binding.lmmse_label_mapping: A1 result method=LMMSE is reported as PC-Wiener in method_label.

panel.no_drop_rule: Every eligible origin and all four users must appear exactly once; any non-ok model prediction is a cell failure.

noise.channel_scale_source: The train-only channel_scale in the exact C0 checkpoint run manifest loaded by the historical A1 runner.
noise.addressing: The existing Philox transform is keyed by environment/origin/user and observed time coordinates. The same transform output is deterministically reproduced across chunk boundaries and methods.
noise.scope: Noise is added only to raw observed history before the saved train normalizer; future targets remain clean.

fit_recipe.execution_device: CPU, matching the historical A1 run to keep NMSE replay numerically comparable.
fit_recipe.Lite: Reuse the same complete C0 speed-specific checkpoint, run manifest, normalizer, and strict state restore used by historical A1.
fit_recipe.PC-Wiener: Reconstruct the historical direct LMMSE empirical moment fit at the same history SNR, with train-only noisy histories and clean targets.
fit_recipe.Ridge: Reconstruct the historical train-only noisy-history direct Ridge moment fit with clean targets.
fit_recipe.AR: Use the historical clean train-only AR fit once per speed; noisy test histories are input at prediction time.
fit_recipe.Kalman: Use the historical clean train-only Kalman fit; pass the nominal history-noise SNR into the frozen measurement-noise branch and keep its loop-parity check.
fit_recipe.Persistence: Use the noisy history's last observed snapshot; no fitted parameters.
fit_recipe.reference_fit_scope: No fit or selection on test data. Classic states are reconstructed because the historical cache contains metrics only.

link.evaluation: RZF at fixed receiver nominal SNR 10 dB, using the existing physical evaluation and precoding implementation. This receiver-side AWGN setting is independent of the history-noise SNR.
link.history_conditions: For each of the 10/20/30 dB history-noise cells, compute link metrics for all six predictors; receiver SNR remains 10 dB in every cell.

coverage.model_conditions: 2 speeds x 3 history-noise SNRs x 6 predictors = 36 conditions, each evaluated on 30 environments (1080 environment-condition link records).
coverage.clean_references: At each speed and environment, compute Perfect and Outdated once in the 10-dB history cell, then reference that same-environment receipt by relative path and SHA-256 in the 20- and 30-dB history cells (60 environment references x 2 methods, 120 reference records total).

link.matrix: For each exact environment/origin, construct one [4 users, 8 Tx, 32 subcarriers] downlink matrix. Evaluate all four users together; do not split or drop users.

clean_references.Perfect: Clean future target channel used as the ideal prediction reference.
clean_references.Outdated: Clean channel at the observed origin, without added observation noise.

link.streaming: One verified test environment and one aligned prediction chunk at a time. Retain environment summaries and identities only; do not save full predictions or noise caches. The Perfect/Outdated results are evaluated in the 10-dB history cell once per environment; 20- and 30-dB cells must verify and reuse the same-speed, same-environment receipt by SHA-256.

analysis_boundary.summary: Per-environment physical NMSE and RZF metrics; origins/users/subcarriers are within-environment observations, not independent replicates.
analysis_boundary.claim_limit: Descriptive receiver-link consequences under this fixed A1 noise recipe only. Do not infer causal effects or tune from formal test results.
